source_snapshot.procedure:
【Before Test】
    1. Check that the SUT configuration (e.g., hardware, firmware, drivers, etc.) matches the specifications/recipe definition.
    2. Clear logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.).

    【During Test】
    1. Login to BMC WebUI.
2. Set power restore policy - Always power on
3. Reboot BMC and make sure the setting is not change.
4. When SUT is power off, unplug AC power cord and replug the power cord. Check SUT power status.

    【After Test】
    1. Collect test results and photos, and save them to specific folders.
    2. Check if there are unexpected logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.) generate after test.
source_snapshot.criteria:
1. Power Restore Policy should not change.
2. SUT power restore behavior should be correct as setting.
    - Alwats power on -> SUT should automatic power on after AC power back.

original_test_intent: Verify AlwaysOn persists across BMC reboot and automatically powers an initially-off SUT on after controlled AC restoration.
original_method: With explicit approval, record original policy and powered-off/workload-safe baseline, set/read back AlwaysOn, reboot BMC and verify persistence, have an operator cycle the correct AC outlet, observe automatic power-on and health recovery, then restore the approved final policy/state.
manual_activity: Owner approves the AlwaysOn enum, automatic-energization safety and final policy. Human operator controls the exact PDU outlet; agent may perform separately approved protected writes/readback and evidence capture only.
safety_requirements: Do not clear logs, hot-pull an active service or energize an unsafe target.
Require exact SUT/outlet and powered-off pre-state confirmation.
Capture original policy before any write and use protected credentials.
Restore/verify the approved final policy and safe operational state.
agent_execution_scope: Static review validates the Project power runbook only.
If separately authorized, capture baseline and set/read back exact AlwaysOn.
Verify persistence after approved BMC reboot.
Observe human PDU AC cycle and bounded automatic power-on/console/health recovery.
Restore final policy/state and return evidence only.
engineer_actions: Approve enum, automatic-energization conditions and final policy.
Authorize each state-changing stage and issue formal verdict.

independent_technical_reasoning: AlwaysOn is persistent configuration plus a physical boot outcome. The SUT must start from a verified off and workload-safe condition, and API persistence cannot prove chassis energization or healthy boot. Exact outlet identity, independent observation and recovery therefore remain mandatory.
